cadence.qualification: Issue-level review follows the existing watches. No fresh assessment, SLA or exhaustive coverage is implied by an index update.

repositoryPublication.qualification: Resolve one full Git commit and read all paths at that commit. publishedAt is the producer timestamp; Git commit availability is repository publication evidence.

liveSiteDelivery.qualification: This feed is published in the repository. Website deployment or D1 health does not establish feed delivery.

producer.qualification: Native editorial publication is required for the existing watches. Coverage stays explicitly bounded; no downstream action or new claim review is implied by this metadata.
